notes.title: Minor Update 0.6.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] FIXED: The game would freeze / hang at the end of a level.
[list][*] The game now continues to run while saving happens in the background.[/list]
[*] FIXED: The leaderboard for Tokyo - Echo Relay was sorted incorrectly.
[list][*] Unfortunately the leaderboard had to be completely reset, but you can still see the ranking before the reset in the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/DXtGfUKve2]Discord[/url][/list]
[/list]

notes.title: The Retro Rankings Update (v0.6)
notes.notes:
This update completely overhauls the game's visual aesthetics, adding lots of new details, optional filters, and even accessibility features. This update also includes the addition of steam leaderboards allowing you to compete with the world to get the highest score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42075401/f260b33bbcaf43b0e5521d375686b95f67812cb1.png[/img]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Integrated steam leaderboards.
[*]Created heavily stylized dynamic lighting.
[*]Added atmospheric particle effects.
[*]Added more options to the settings menu.
[list]
[*][Display filters (Choose between a Modern, LCD, or CRT display filter.)
[*]Motion blur
[*]Low intensity sensitivity filter
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42075401/2686e23cc911caab85a93b46a2c3a0ef6863ae84.png[/img]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changed many levels to use gradient wireframes.
[*]Revamped the Déjà Vu effect.
[*]Stylized the bloom effect.
[*]Changed Tokyo's into cutscene.
[*]Added an into cutscene to Miami.
[*]Reworked most of the game's shaders. (This change [i]should[/i] be subtle.)
[*]Objects which snapped in/out of existence when far away should now fade instead.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed bugs related to pausing.
[*]Cars will no longer get stuck on the jet in Area 51.
[*]Time-attack stars should no longer have incorrect times.
[*]It should no longer be possible to drive/fall infinitely out of bounds in Miami.
[*]Added more devices to list of [b]potentially[/b] supported Logitech Steering Wheels. They are not all guaranteed to work, but the game will at least try to use them.
[*]Various other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: The Retro Rankings Leaderboard Battle
notes.notes:
Get ready for some friendly competition on Tuesday, May 14 2024 at 12:00 pm EDT. Sometime this week, we'll release the Retro Rankings update! Since this update adds leaderboards, we'll be holding a competition to see who can climb to the top of the leaderboard in certain levels by the end of the day!

[h2][url=https://discord.gg/HgRwfMNm?event=1237485826405826733]Join the Déjà Drift Discord[/url][/h2]
The event will be hosted on the officlai [url=https://discord.gg/HgRwfMNm?event=1237485826405826733]Déjà Drift Discord Server[/url] and will be streamed on the
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/barinteractive]BAR Interactive Twitch channel[/url].

To participate, you will need to own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1914390/Dj_Drift/]Déjà Drift[/url]. You'll also want to make sure you've unlocked as many levels as possible before the event!

notes.title: The Tokyo Update (v0.5)
notes.notes:
Turn the rubble from a Kaiju attack on Tokyo into your personal playground! Crash through the windows of skyscrapers to a J-Pop inspired Eurobeat soundtrack. With 4 new levels, new challenges, and even some tweaks to other maps, this update brings lots of new adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42075401/09c7469015379475dd31e0db0130fc28b682a6de.png[/img]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added New Map: Tokyo.
[*]Added 4 Levels for Tokyo.
[*]Added new soundtrack for Tokyo: *Echoes of Your Love (feat. DJ World Domination)*.
[*]Added support for Kilometers.
[*]Added updated models to Miami.
[*]Updated graphics of some models in Area 51.
[/list]

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated Unity version to 2022 LTS.
[*]Reworked the level select screen to show a list to accommodate the increased number of levels.
[*]Made boxes destructible. (Helps prevent car from launching into the air randomly.)
[*]Various quality-of-life improvements to the UI.
[*]Some physics-related performance improvements.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42075401/1d743599b0de91032fda44ae82775e895bc8dbfb.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes for version 0.4.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game version is now displayed in bottom right corner of the title screen.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] FIXED: Orb stars can't be earned in explore mode after restart.
[*] FIXED: Brakes have no analog control.
[*] FIXED: Cannot control pause menu with controller when tutorial dialog is open.
[*] FIXED: Camera view can change while in pause menu. (Distracting for D-Pad users)
[*] FIXED: Game breaks when pausing between rounds after restart.
[*] FIXED: Round timer ends early for first round after restart.
[*] FIXED: Resolution sometimes changes after manually choosing resolution in settings.
[*] FIXED: Car can teleport under the mall on Miami - Echo Relay during Echo 2.
[/list]

[h2]Linux Beta[/h2]
Experimental Linux support has been added as a beta branch. The Linux build may be highly unstable depending on the machine configuration, and may cause bright flashing graphical artifacts. To opt-in to the Linux beta, go to the Déjà Drift properties in Steam, and change beta participation to linux-beta.
